uk.s: HTX is excited to roll out the limited-time MAPO Bonanza, featuring a massive 9,226,469 MAPO prize pool (worth $10,000).

Participants who trade MAPO during the event will share 922,710 MAPO (worth $1,000) based on their ranking in terms of spot trading volume.
Margin Trading Volume Boost: During the event period, MAPO margin trading volume will be tripled (3x) when calculating participants' total trading volume.
A share of 479,810 MAPO (worth $520) in proportion of their trading volume (Min volume: 20 USDT)

(Note: Throughout the event, visit the event page on any given day to get automatically enrolled in the event, and your trading volume during the event period will be calculated. Failure to do so will disqualify you from receiving any rewards.)
[Event 4: Daily Trading Check-Ins for a Share of $2,000]
Share 369,085 MAPO (worth $400) proportionally based on cumulative net buy volume
Share 553,627 MAPO (worth $600) proportionally based on cumulative net buy volume
Share 922,712 MAPO (worth $1,000) proportionally based on cumulative net buy volume

(Note: Net spot buy volume for designated tokens = Buy amount − Sell amount − Withdrawal amount. During the event, the check-in duration per day lasts from 10:00 (UTC) of a day to 09:59 (UTC) the next day.)
SVIP users (Prime 5 or above) whose spot trading volume of MAPO reaches ≥ 50,000 USDT will have a chance to win up to $880!
For ordinary market makers, only their Taker trading volumes will be considered for the Event 3 and Event 5.
Activity 3 Eligibility: Visit the event page to enroll automatically, and your trading volume during the event period will be tracked. Failure to do so will disqualify you from receiving any rewards.
Sub-accounts cannot be used to participate in this event. Trading volumes from sub-accounts will be counted towards their main accounts.

Only spot trading volume with trading fees paid is counted towards this event. Trades with zero trading fees, negative fee rates, spot trading fee rebate vouchers, or trading bots trial bonuses are not included in the volume calculation for the event.

Rewards will be credited to winners' HTX accounts within 14 working days after the end of the events. If winners have not received their rewards after 14 working days, please contact our 24/7 online Customer Support or email htxsupport@htx-inc.com for assistance.

HTX will strictly review and disqualify any participants who show any signs of fraudulent behaviors, such as malicious inflation of trading volume, bulk registration of fake accounts, wash trading, and order matching.
*Complete both the net deposit and single stock order volume requirements to receive rewards.
Achieve a total net purchase of ≥ 200 USDT after registration and hold for ≥ 48h.

Why is the AI theme gaining market attention?

Global capex has entered a supercycle: Hyperscale cloud providers and frontier AI labs continue to ramp up investment in AI infrastructure, with capital expanding from model training into inference, data centers, and supporting power infrastructure. Wall Street increasingly views AI as a key force reshaping economic growth and corporate earnings.
